name: Virag Flyer Library
principles: Use only the current flyer brief, current composer text and current uploads.
Never reuse an older flyer topic, campaign, offer, festival, headline or CTA unless explicitly referenced.
Create one standalone finished flyer unless another quantity is explicitly requested.
Prioritize one dominant hook, one clear CTA when supported, strong hierarchy and 2–3 second readability.
Preserve supplied facts exactly and never invent prices, dates, offers, rewards, claims or event details.
Food/restaurant flyers should feel appetizing and brand-specific rather than template-like.
Repeated requests must materially change layout, hero treatment, typography, visual story and composition.

commands.label: Campaign Flyer
commands.desc: Best-fit promotional flyer for the current brief.
commands.instruction: Create one finished campaign flyer for the current brief only. Use one dominant hook, clear hierarchy, strong brand/category fit and one CTA when supported. Do not reuse any older flyer topic or campaign.

commands.label: Promo Flyer
commands.desc: General promotion with strong campaign hierarchy.
commands.instruction: Create one promotional flyer for the current offer/product/service using only supplied facts. Make the promotion easy to understand in 2–3 seconds and avoid generic template styling.

commands.label: Offer Flyer
commands.desc: Offer-led flyer without inventing deal details.
commands.instruction: Create one offer-led flyer using only the exact supplied discount, price, bundle or promotion details. If no factual offer is supplied, do not invent one; instead build the visual structure around the current message.

commands.label: Event Flyer
commands.instruction: Create one event flyer using the exact supplied event name, date, time, location and participant details. Prioritize event hierarchy, atmosphere and fast readability without inventing missing event information.

commands.label: Restaurant Flyer
commands.desc: Restaurant promotion with appetite-led art direction.
commands.instruction: Create one restaurant flyer from the current food/restaurant brief. Use appetizing hero food, brand-fit environment and clear message hierarchy. Avoid generic menu-board styling unless requested.

commands.label: Food Flyer
commands.instruction: Create one food-focused promotional flyer using the current dish/product image as the visual hero. Preserve visible food identity and use premium appetite cues, strong typography and concise factual copy.

commands.label: Loyalty Flyer
commands.instruction: Create one loyalty or membership flyer using only supplied reward mechanics and facts. Make participation and value easy to understand while avoiding invented benefits or conditions.

commands.label: Launch Flyer
commands.desc: New launch announcement with strong reveal energy.
commands.instruction: Create one launch flyer for the current product/service/event. Build anticipation and a strong reveal hierarchy using only supplied launch facts. Do not invent launch dates, availability or claims.

commands.label: Festival Flyer
commands.desc: Festival campaign adapted to the current brand.
commands.instruction: Create one festival flyer only when the current brief explicitly names or clearly requires a festival/occasion. Adapt the visual language to the brand and avoid generic cliché decoration or pulling an old festival from chat history.

commands.label: Announcement Flyer
commands.desc: Clear announcement with strong message hierarchy.
commands.instruction: Create one announcement flyer for the current supplied message. Make the announcement the dominant readable element, support it with relevant brand visuals, and preserve all factual details exactly.
